title: Transportation Optimization: Implementation plan
summary: Minimize total supplier-to-customer cash distribution cost while satisfying all customer demand and respecting supplier supply and transportation-capacity limits.. Implementation plan evidence captured from the governed transportation workflow.

payload.routeExceptionProcess: If a recommended supplier-to-customer route is unavailable, delayed, or operationally blocked, operations should record the exception, identify the affected supplier, customer, quantity, and reason, and use the approved fallback route or rerun the optimization with updated route availability and capacity assumptions. Exceptions should be reconciled against the optimized allocation plan before closeout.
payload.fallbackPlan: If the optimized allocation cannot be executed as approved, use the most recent feasible allocation plan as the fallback. If demand, supplier capacity, transport capacity, or route availability materially changes, rerun the Transportation / Logistics optimization before execution. For urgent disruptions, prioritize full demand coverage using available approved routes, then document cost variance and capacity exceptions.
payload.reconciliationProcess: After execution, compare the approved allocation plan with actual shipped quantities, route usage, costs, exceptions, and unmet demand. Document variances by supplier, customer, and route. Confirm whether all demand was fulfilled, whether capacity limits were respected, and whether actual cost remained within the approved tolerance. Capture lessons learned and update assumptions before the next optimization cycle.
